name: Coaster Set
description: A set of flat drink coasters with a pattern, monogram letter, text or your own SVG/PNG picture inlaid flush in a second colour, and an optional border ring in a third. Round, square, hexagon or rounded-square; up to 12 laid out on one plate; optional recess underneath for a cork or felt pad and an optional holder for the stack. For drinks to stand on, not a food-contact item.
source: inspired by Printables Sunflower fabric coaster (#285153, 40,326 downloads) and Leaf Drink Coasters with Decorative Plant Holder (#230363, 19,486 downloads)
